title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Procuratorate on How to Handle Cases Where a Criminal Suspect Escapes or Suffers from a Serious Illness During the Period of Review and Prosecution

articles.content_en: I. When the People's Procuratorate handles a case for examination and prosecution where the criminal suspect is in custody, it shall strictly conclude the case within the time limit prescribed by law. If the case cannot be concluded according to law, the criminal suspect shall be released or the compulsory measures shall be changed in accordance with Article 96 of the Criminal Procedure Law.

II. For a case transferred by an investigation authority to the People's Procuratorate for examination and prosecution, if the criminal suspect escapes, the People's Procuratorate shall, in accordance with Article 154, paragraph 3 of the Criminal Procedure Rules of the People's Procuratorate (for Trial Implementation), require the investigation authority to take measures to ensure the criminal suspect appears before transferring the case for examination and prosecution.

III. If during the process of examination and prosecution the People's Procuratorate discovers that a criminal suspect has escaped, it shall promptly notify the investigation authority and require the investigation authority to carry out pursuit and arrest activities.
The People's Procuratorate shall promptly and thoroughly review the case files and materials. Upon review, if the facts of the case are unclear and the evidence is insufficient, it may, in accordance with Article 171, paragraph 2 of the Criminal Procedure Law and Article 380 of the Criminal Procedure Rules of the People's Procuratorate (for Trial Implementation), return the case to the investigation authority for supplementary investigation.
After the investigation authority completes supplementary investigation and transfers the case for examination and prosecution, the People's Procuratorate shall conduct the examination in accordance with the provisions of Article 2 of this Reply.
If some criminal suspects in a joint crime escape, the examination and prosecution of other criminal suspects shall proceed as normal.

V. If during the period of examination and prosecution, a criminal suspect escapes or dies and the conditions stipulated in Article 280, paragraph 1 of the Criminal Procedure Law are met, the People's Procuratorate may submit an application to the People's Court for confiscation of illegal gains.
This is a reply.
Supreme People's Procuratorate
December 27, 2013
